verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence for bulk triage is a homepage claim: "Identify important emails & todos with a single click. Sweep away the rest." That implies a one-stroke bulk dismissal of remaining mail, and community users praise 'mark as done' and fast inbox clearing, but nothing documents selecting an arbitrary set of conversations and applying archive, label or done to them together. AI filters that auto-label and auto-archive are rule-based automation, not interactive multi-select, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented multi-select of arbitrary conversations, bulk labeling, bulk archive of a chosen selection, keyboard or shortcut details for bulk actions, hands-on corroboration of bulk selection.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
